sources.title: Data sources
sources.computed: Health score, outdated status, major version distance, license classes and ratios are computed by this app from the values above.

fields.npmRegistry: versions, publish dates, deprecation messages, license, maintainers, repository URL

definitions.lastPublished: Publish date of the version the npm "latest" dist-tag points to, from the npm registry "time" field. Ages count calendar months back from the report generation date.
definitions.lastUpdated: Last modification time of the package document in the npm registry ("time.modified"). Any change to the package document, such as a publish, sets this time.
definitions.installedVersionAge: Publish date of the installed version, from the npm registry "time" field. A version range reads as its lowest version.
definitions.commitActivity: Default-branch commits within the last {commitWindowDays} days, from the repository host API. The lookup reads at most {commitSampleSize} commits, so counts top out at {commitSampleSize}. "No commits in N months": no commit in the window, or the newest commit is older than N months.
definitions.openPrRatio: Open pull requests divided by open plus closed pull requests, from the repository host search API. A missing count, or fewer than {ratioMinSample} pull requests in total, counts as Unknown.
definitions.openIssueRatio: Open issues divided by open plus closed issues, from the repository host search API. A missing count, or fewer than {ratioMinSample} issues in total, counts as Unknown.
definitions.vulnerabilities: Number of advisories the OSV database lists for the package name in the npm ecosystem, across all versions of the package.
definitions.bundleSize: Minified + gzipped size from Bundlephobia: of the installed version for a pinned version, else of the latest version. Dev dependencies are not measured and show "-".
definitions.healthScore: Score from 0 to {scoreMax}, computed by this app, not by a data source. Weighted average of the available signals: latest release age (weight {weightReleaseAge}; full rating up to {staleFreshMonths} months, zero at {staleWorstMonths} months), deprecation (weight {weightDeprecated}), outdated version (weight {weightOutdated}), maintainer count (weight {weightMaintainers}; zero at 1, full at {maintainersBest}), open issue ratio (weight {weightIssues}; zero at {issueRatioWorst}), known vulnerabilities (weight {weightVulnerabilities}; zero at 1 or more). Unavailable signals are left out. Bands: Poor 0-{poorMax}, Fair {fairMin}-{fairMax}, Good {goodMin}-{scoreMax}.
definitions.status: Deprecated: the npm registry holds a deprecation message for the installed version, quoted verbatim. Outdated: the installed version is lower than the npm "latest" version. Major version behind: the major number of the latest version is higher than the installed one.
definitions.maintainers: Maintainer accounts listed in the npm registry package document.
definitions.adoption: Downloads in the last 7 days, from the npm downloads API.
definitions.license: License field of the installed version in the npm registry, else of the package document. Copyleft: GPL, AGPL, LGPL, MPL, EPL, CDDL, OSL, EUPL or SSPL family. Custom: "SEE LICENSE IN", "UNLICENSED" or a value not shaped like an SPDX expression.
definitions.source: Repository URL from the npm registry "repository" field. No repository: the field is missing or not an http(s) URL.
